tables.name: Furnishings
tables.description: Modified by Expense and Condition. The quality of the keep's furnishings and amenities.

results.name: Poor
results.description: The contents of the keep are very simplistic, of inferior quality, or are in a state of disrepair.

results.name: Basic
results.description: Most of the contents of the keep are very basic, of poor quality, or in poor condition, though some may be decent.

results.name: Decent
results.description: The contents of the keep are of serviceable quality, or in good condition.

results.name: Good
results.description: Most of the contents of the keep are of decent quality, or in good condition, and some may be excellent or in fine condition.

results.name: Fine
results.description: The contents of the keep are all of superlative quality, or are in excellent condition.
